standard.description: Title, version as printed, source file, sha256 and page count of the document.

profile_file.description: Where the profile JSON was written, or the file that was validated.

profile_artifact_id.description: Session artifact id of the profile; pass it to log_compliance_auditor.

counts.description: Requirement counts: total, testable against records, by assessable_from and by obligation.

quote_check.description: How many quotes were found, not found, or not checked in the document text.

notes.description: What was dropped, coerced or could not be read.

calls.description: One entry per model call: provider, model version, transport, truncation.
